title: rudgea coronata subsp. saint-hilairei
intro: Rudgea coronata subsp. saint-hilairei, commonly known as Rudgea saint-hilairei, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to the Brazilian Atlantic Forest. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, supporting the treatment of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rudgea saint-hilairei include antioxidant, anti-proliferative, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential candidate for the management of oxidative stress, cancer, and inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Rudgea saint-hilairei include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
